options.opa: One of the subunits of the DNA polymerase enzyme that adds nucleotides in the 3'-5 'direction.
options.opb: Small fragments of DNA that contain a STOP codon.
options.opc: Small fragments of DNA that allow the replication of the DNA strand in the 3'-5 'direction.
options.opd: Small fragments of RNA that are synthesized at the beginning of the DNA transcription process.
